question: Which of the following instruments is used to measure the piston ring end gap in a cylinder?
solution:
__Explanation:__

Feeler gauge:

 
• A feeler gauge is used for checking the gap between mating parts.
 
• The piston ring end gap is measured by a feeler gauge.
 
• A feeler gauge consists of a number of hardened and tempered steel blades of various thicknesses mounted in a steel case.
